comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Cutting tools, measuring tools and consumer first aid kits sold to retailers; not medical device manufacturing for hospitals.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Generic and specialty prescription drugs; a pharmaceutical business, not medical devices.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Injectable and inhalation drugs plus diagnostic kits; drug manufacturing rather than device products.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Orthopedic bone-healing stimulators, biologics and cartilage implants sold to surgeons; different product lines from Teleflex's catheters and anesthesia devices.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Designs and sells interventional and surgical implant and monitoring devices to hospitals and cath labs, overlapping Teleflex's interventional and surgical customers.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Dental implants, aligners and orthodontic products sold to dental professionals; a different end market.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Disposable IV infusion sets, vascular access products and pumps sold to hospitals and group purchasing organizations, matching Teleflex's vascular access lines.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Opioid use disorder prescription medicines; a pharmaceutical business, not devices.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Surgical instruments and implants designed and made in-house, sold to hospitals and surgeons through direct sales and distributors, like Teleflex's surgical lines.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: Radiopharmaceutical imaging agents and isotope generators; a drug and radioisotope business.

comps.label: C11
comps.reason: Noninvasive patient monitoring, pulse oximetry and consumer wearables; different products from Teleflex's disposable therapy devices.

comps.label: C12
comps.reason: Disposable catheters, guidewires and inflation devices for minimally invasive procedures sold to hospitals and physicians, closely matching Teleflex.

comps.label: C13
comps.reason: Tissue-based skin substitutes and wound matrices reimbursed by payers; not Teleflex's device lines.

comps.label: C14
comps.reason: Branded injectable drugs and a nerve-pain device; drug-led business rather than Teleflex's device lines.

comps.label: C15
comps.reason: Home sleep apnea CPAP and masks sold largely to patients and home equipment dealers; differs from Teleflex's hospital anesthesia and respiratory disposables.

comps.label: C16
comps.reason: Diversified mix of tapes, dental products, coding software and documentation services; no single matching business.

comps.label: C17
comps.reason: Pneumatic compression devices for lymphedema used at home and reimbursed by insurers; a different product and customer.

comps.label: C18
comps.reason: Spine implants and bone graft products used by spine surgeons; orthopedic implants rather than Teleflex's device lines.
